title: AURA-KSP: Stream Reduction for Skeleton Action Recognition — Code, Models and Reproducible Results
description: Research software, fixed protocols, trained checkpoints and saved predictions for the Full-4 versus Stream-3 NTU RGB+D 120 XSet comparison. The artifact includes CPU scripts for independently reproducing aggregate metrics and paired setup-bootstrap analyses, original latency traces, negative temporal-reduction results, and documented scope limitations. Raw NTU RGB+D data are not redistributed. Earlier latency measurements used seed-271828 models; final checkpoints were not retimed. This research has been funded by the Science Committee of the Ministry of Science and Higher Education of the Republic of Kazakhstan (Grant No. AP23486538 Research and development of a system for recognizing images in video streams based on artificial intelligence).
